__comment: The compact object panel beside the dock (doc 260). Each provider action id gets a picture and a line of hover text; the provider's own text stays the button's name. Actions with no entry keep their words on a tan button. DEV actions show dev_icon on the dev tile, apart from the rest. Badges name the picture in the white pill. Owned by UIRegistry.

move.tooltip: Choose a new spot. A dwarf packs this piece, carries it there and installs it.

uninstall.tooltip: A dwarf packs this piece into a crate for storage.

cancel_move.tooltip: Keep the piece where it stands.

cancel.tooltip: Call off this order. Work already done is kept.

assign_bed.tooltip: Choose who sleeps here, or leave the bed to anyone.

permission.tooltip: Dwarves leave disallowed goods where they are.

place.tooltip: Choose where a dwarf sets this stone down.

follow.tooltip: Keep the camera on this dwarf. Moving the camera stops following.

locate.tooltip: Center the camera on this dwarf.

character_sheet.tooltip: Everything about this dwarf: work, needs, equipment and profession.

stop_follow.tooltip: Keep the camera on this animal. Moving the camera stops following.

fell.tooltip: A dwarf chops this tree down for its logs.

harvest.tooltip: A dwarf picks the ripe crop; the plant stays.

cancel_felling.tooltip: Call off this order. Work already done is kept.

uproot.tooltip: A dwarf lifts the whole plant for storage or replanting.

pause.tooltip: Stop work for now; what is built stays.

remove.tooltip: Dwarves take it apart and recover its parts.

reopen.tooltip: Stop dismantling and open it again.

pack.tooltip: A dwarf packs this into an item for storage.
